facts.text: Andrew finds city living challenging due to the lack of connection to nature and companionship.

evidence.quote: I hear ya. Can’t do that here unfortunately, city living makes it hard. Really miss that connection and companionship.
It really does. Sometimes it feels like I'm missing out.

facts.text: Audrey acknowledges the difficulty of city life without access to nature and suggests finding ways to connect with it.

evidence.quote: Must be tough living in the city without the opportunity to go outside. Sure is a different experience.
It must be tough. City life can get overwhelming, so it's great to find ways to connect to nature.

facts.text: Andrew mentions that nature has a soothing effect and helps him reset when life becomes chaotic.

evidence.quote: It's like hitting the reset button when life gets too chaotic. Nature has a way of being really soothing.

facts.text: Andrew and his girlfriend enjoy discovering new places to eat in the city as a way to relax and try new things.

evidence.quote: My girlfriend and I love to discover new places to eat around town. It's a great way to try something new and wind down after a long week.
